name: The Red Sands (Djurum)
theme: Sun-Baked Desert, Fighting Pits & Burning Tombs (Cursed Scroll 2)
hazardTable: Blinding sandstorm (DC 12 CON or blinded and disoriented)
Extreme heat exhaustion (DC 13 CON or consume double water)
Shifting sink-dune (DC 12 DEX or tumble into pit)
Sunstroke mirage (DC 11 WIS or waste half day chasing false oasis)
weatherTable: Warm desert breeze with clear skies
Scorching sirocco gusts whipping crimson sand
Brisk dry breeze kicking up sand grains

factions.name: Thraxis Arena Masters
factions.notes: Host grand combat tournaments, recruit skilled mercenaries, and enforce martial honor.

factions.name: Burning Brothers
factions.notes: Cleanse the desert with flame and claim ancient solar relics for their salamander god.

factions.name: Djurum Water Keepers
factions.notes: Repair cracked conduits, ration spring water, and punish those who pollute the wells.

uniqueFloraFauna: Perennial artesian spring fed by deep sandstone aquifers
Date palms, goat milk, roasted barley, and imported figs
entryConditions: Expedition access point into The Red Sands (Djurum).
